title: people-ops recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad 2026-03-15
content:
Daily scratchpad — quick hits, reminders, and TODOs (people-ops recruiting coordinator)
Date: 2026-03-15
Owner: Avery Chen

TODAY (high priority)
- 9:00am PT: Confirm panel for SRE candidate (María Torres) — panel: Jordan (infra), Priya (sre), Sam (sre). Need Jordan confirmation (he said maybe). ACTION: ping Jordan on Slack now + add fallback interviewer if no response by 9:30am.
- 10:30am PT: Phone screen — Chris Nguyen (GH-12345). Send calendar invite + resume to interviewer (Priya). Interviewer prep note: focus on on-call experience + debugging.
- 11:00am PT: Follow-up email to Product Design candidates (round 1) — template updated yesterday. Pull list from GH tag: pd-round1-2026-03. ACTION: send by EOD.
- 2:00pm PT: Onsite scheduling for Backend Eng (4 candidates) — block tentative windows for Apr 6 & 7. Check room availability with office-ops.
- 3:15pm PT: Update Greenhouse statuses for yesterday's interviews (leave notes + move next stage). Few missing feedback items: Kate R., Dev coding test not scored yet. Remind interviewers to submit by EOD tomorrow.

FOLLOW-UPS / EMAILS TO SEND
- Follow-up: María Torres — confirm panel (if Jordan declines, propose Priya + Sam + fallback: Daniel). Use short note: "Thanks — just confirming your panel and logistics, expect 90-minute loop, video link will be sent upon confirmation."
- Follow-up: Chris Nguyen — scheduling confirmation + timezone check (he's in EST). Provide Zoom link and recruiter phone number.
- Candidate no-show yesterday (Backend): send reschedule option + apology template.

SCHEDULING NOTES & TZs
- Candidate notes: Chris Nguyen (EST) — 10:30am PT = 1:30pm EST. Add timezone in invite and mention local time in email.
- María (Madrid) — currently CET (UTC+1) — double-check daylight saving dates. Proposed panel 9:00am PT = 6:00pm CET. Confirm if that works for candidate and interviewers.

PIPELINE / TRACKERS
- Greenhouse tags to update after sends: pd-round1-2026-03 (move to screen), be-round2-2026-03 (move candidates with take-home test complete).
- JIRA: JIRA-RECRUIT-112 — rolling update for hiring coordinator SOP; need to add new 'no-show' follow-up step.

NOTES TO SELF (informal)
- Use new email template for "next steps" — fewer bullets, one-liner scheduling options.
- Remind hiring manager (Lee) to clarify onsite agenda for Backend Eng loop (coding test + design review + culture).
- Check office-ops about visitor badges for Apr 6 (capacity limits).

BLOCKERS
- Jordan hasn't confirmed availability for María panel (blocks confirmation).
- Kate R. coding test scoring missing — ping Sam and set a 24hr deadline.

TEMPLATES / SNIPPETS (copy-paste)
- Quick scheduler note: "Hi {candidate_name}, thanks for your flexibility. We have availability on {date1} or {date2}. Which works best? The interview will be a {length}-minute loop with {roles}."
- Reschedule no-show: "Hi {candidate_name}, we missed you for your scheduled interview. Are you still interested? If so, please select a new time here [link] or reply with availability."

END-OF-DAY CHECKLIST
- Send PD round 1 follow-ups (email + GH update).
- Confirm María panel by 10am PT or propose new panel within 30 min.
- Remind interviewers with missing feedback (Kate R. + others).
- Update calendar invites (timezones explicit).

MISC NOTES / FYI
- Upcoming: All-hands recruiting sync on Fri 2026-03-19 — bring candidate pipeline metrics.
- Recruiter 1:1 with Priya tomorrow — agenda: prioritization, candidate experience follow-ups, new scheduling tool pilot.

08:32 AM: checked GH — 3 new applicants for PD
08:45 AM: pinged Jordan in Slack (pending)
09:12 AM: added tentative onsite blocks for Apr 6/7
09:40 AM: sent prep note to Priya for Chris screen
